images.original: LOL WAS TRYING TO FIGURE OUT SOMETHING THAT I FORGOT.jpg
images.description: Sanjid in a face mask and gloves, looking closely at a power electronics board with a toroid inductor, large capacitors and an aluminium heatsink. Whiteboard with circuit sketches behind him, solder and a multimeter on the desk.
images.context: Charger era at ZEROOZEN by date and hardware. Which product the board belongs to is not stated.
images.story: Shows the site's opening line literally. Sanjid's own caption says he was trying to figure out something he forgot.
images.quality: Good. Sharp on the board, natural light, slightly busy background.
images.alt: Sanjid, wearing a mask and gloves, inspecting a circuit board up close.
images.caption: Trying to figure out something I had forgotten. May 2024.

images.description: Sanjid smiling, hands in pockets, standing beside a backlit EMK Center sign on a grey plaster wall. Black T-shirt with a lightning bolt logo.
images.context: EMK Center (sign visible). Why he was there is not stated.
images.context_confidence: high for place, none for occasion
images.story: The clearest, friendliest picture of his face. Tells a first-time visitor who Sanjid is.
images.quality: Very good. Clean background, even light.
images.alt: Sanjid smiling beside the EMK Center sign.
images.caption: At the EMK Center, Dhaka.

images.description: Black and white candid of Sanjid with longer, curly hair, looking down at a phone, seated on a tufted sofa.
images.story: Quiet, unposed. Already black and white, so it sits naturally in the site.
images.alt: Black and white photo of Sanjid looking down at his phone.
images.caption: A quiet one.

images.description: Sanjid in a graduation gown and sash in front of a gold backdrop reading 12th Convocation 2025, Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology.
images.context: AUST 12th convocation, 2025 (backdrop text). He studied there 2018 to 2022 (CV).
images.story: Closes the university chapter of About.
images.quality: Good. Warm, busy backdrop that turns flat grey in black and white.
images.alt: Sanjid in a graduation gown at the AUST 12th convocation.
images.caption: AUST’s 12th convocation, 2025.

images.description: Sanjid seated at a desk by a barred window overlooking the city. A hot air rework station, loose wires and boards, and a monitor showing a web dashboard with a chart and a reading of 210.0.
images.context: Sanjid's file name: the early days of a ThingSpeak server. November 2023 (camera date). Which project it logged is not stated.
images.story: The start of his ZEROOZEN years. Hardware and data on the same desk.
images.quality: Fair. Backlit, face in shadow. Honest rather than polished.
images.alt: Sanjid at a cluttered workbench by a window, with a data dashboard on the monitor.
images.caption: The early days of a ThingSpeak server. November 2023.

images.description: Selfie of Sanjid grinning beside two black wall-mounted chargers with lit lightning bolt logos and red emergency stop buttons, on a rough brick wall next to a switchboard.
images.context: Sanjid's file name: first version of the ZenWall chargers. March 2024 (camera date). The setting looks like a working site, not a lab, but whose site is not stated.
images.context_confidence: high for product, low for place
images.story: The charger leaving the bench and going on a real wall. The selfie carries how he felt about it.
images.alt: Sanjid taking a selfie beside two wall-mounted chargers on a brick wall.
images.caption: The first version of the ZenWall chargers, on a wall. March 2024.

images.original: SANJID  CO. AT MEET BANGLADESHE EXPO.jpg
images.description: Sanjid with an event lanyard in front of a stand titled Our Product Offerings, showing three ZEROOZEN chargers named ZenLite, ZenGo and ZenWall with rated power and battery support panels.
images.context: Meet Bangladesh expo (file name and badge). Date unknown.
images.context_confidence: high for event, none for date
images.story: Where the charger work ended up: a family of products shown in public.
images.alt: Sanjid at an expo stand in front of three wall-mounted chargers.
images.caption: With the charger line at the Meet Bangladesh expo.

images.original: DELIVERING THE FIRST LOT OF ZENGO ALFA VEHICLE 12.50AM AT NIGHT.jpg
images.description: At night on a street, several people push an orange ZEROOZEN electric three wheeler up a ramp into a shipping container. Another vehicle is already inside.
images.context: Sanjid's file name: delivering the first lot of ZENGO ALFA vehicles, 12:50 at night. Camera date 19 September 2025, 00:28. ZENGO ALFA launched September 2025 (CV). Who the people are is not stated.
images.story: The launch was not a stage. It was people pushing vehicles into a container after midnight.
images.quality: Fair. Low light, some motion blur. Strong moment.
images.alt: People pushing an orange electric three wheeler up a ramp into a container at night.
images.caption: Loading the first lot of ZENGO ALFA vehicles, after midnight. September 2025.

images.original: onboarding zeroozens first garage partner shariful garage.jpg
images.description: Three men in matching black lightning bolt T-shirts at the entrance of a garage full of painted rickshaws. Sanjid is on the left. They hold a notebook with a banknote on it together. A spare wheel rim and a pump lean on the wall.
images.context: Sanjid's file name: onboarding Shariful Garage, ZEROOZEN's first garage partner. April 2024 (camera date). Names of the other two men are not stated.
images.context_confidence: high for event, none for people
images.story: The world the work is for: a real garage, real vehicles, the first partner.
images.quality: Very good. Clear faces, rich setting.
images.alt: Sanjid and two men holding a notebook at the entrance of a rickshaw garage.
images.caption: Onboarding Shariful Garage, ZEROOZEN’s first garage partner. April 2024.

images.description: Sanjid in a ZEROOZEN T-shirt standing by a desk with an assembly of blue cylindrical cells wired with sense leads, a boxed lithium battery and a tall RePower cabinet behind.
images.context: April 2026 (camera date). No file name context. Whether the cells are a ZenPack is not stated.
images.story: The most recent photo. Fits Now, which is about batteries and BMS.
images.alt: Sanjid standing beside a battery cell assembly on a desk.
images.caption: April 2026.

images.description: Sanjid holding a framed Orange Corners Bangladesh certificate of achievement awarded to Zeroozen for graduating from the 2nd cohort of the incubation programme. Framed photographs on the wall behind.
images.context: Certificate text is readable. Camera date August 2024, so the cohort finished by then.
images.story: Evidence for the Orange Corners line. A milestone, so it stays small.
images.alt: Sanjid holding a framed Orange Corners Bangladesh certificate.
images.caption: Orange Corners Bangladesh, second cohort. August 2024.

images.description: Sanjid in a red T-shirt standing with a mountain bike in a field of yellow mustard flowers, trees and a bamboo fence behind, overcast sky.
images.story: Life outside work. The bicycle appears in four of the sixteen photos.
images.quality: Fair. Older phone, subject small. The yellow is lost in black and white.
images.alt: Sanjid standing with his bicycle in a mustard field.
images.caption: December 2017.

images.description: Younger Sanjid in cycling gloves holding a bicycle on a narrow village road, a cycle rickshaw behind him. Square crop with white side borders.
images.story: An early picture of him. Rickshaws were already in the frame.
images.quality: Good. Had white side borders from an editing app, cropped off in the web copy.
images.alt: A younger Sanjid with his bicycle on a village road.
images.caption: July 2017.

images.description: Ground level view along an empty asphalt road at dawn with mist and trees. A bicycle's wheels stand on the sandy verge on the left.
images.context: No date or place. Probably taken by Sanjid but not stated.
images.story: Shows how he looks at things. Low to the ground, close to the road.
images.alt: A misty road at dawn seen from ground level, with bicycle wheels on the verge.
images.caption: An early ride.

images.description: A black and green bicycle on its kickstand on a city street at night under streetlights. Other cyclists in the background.
images.context: File name suggests July 2017. Place not stated.
images.story: Same theme as the dawn road photo, weaker.
images.quality: Fair. Low resolution (833 px), heavy edit.
images.alt: A bicycle parked on a city street at night.
images.caption: Night ride. 2017.

images.description: Eight young men, arms around each other, each kicking one leg up, beside a large bonfire at night. Sanjid is on the far left.
images.context: Sanjid's file name says 31 December 2021. The camera date says 1 January 2023, 01:04. The year is uncertain. The friends are not named.
images.story: The friend. Joy, nothing to do with work.
images.alt: Sanjid and seven friends kicking their legs up beside a bonfire at night.
images.caption: New Year’s Eve with friends.
